layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Filter-feeder diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish tiny marine shrimp made of smooth clay
The shrimp is bright orange clay with a simple segmented body, a happy face, and tiny rounded antennae
Thick, curved form with smooth edges to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay shrimp sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate a filter-feeding diet for a children's matching game. No text.
